title: 08 Parker

sections.title: Charlie Parker: Bebop and Harmonic Velocity

blocks.text: Charlie 'Bird' Parker (1920–1955) revolutionised alto saxophone with bebop — fast harmonic rhythm, chromatic lines, improvisation on chord changes.
*Confirmation*, *Blues for Alice*, *Ko-Ko*, *Ornithology* (based on *How High the Moon*). Tunes became études for jazz musicians worldwide.
Legendary woodshedding — 11–15 hours daily in youth. Oral tradition plus rigorous technique produces new vocabulary.
Target chord tones on strong beats; chromatic approaches between. Apply sparingly on modal tunes.

- A) Bebop
- B) Dixieland only
- C) 1980s smooth jazz
- D) Gregorian chant

**Answer:** A

sections.title: Q2. Bebop emphasises navigating chord changes chromatically.

quiz_markdown:
### Q1. Parker central to:

- A) Bebop
- B) Dixieland only
- C) 1980s smooth jazz
- D) Gregorian chant

**Answer:** A

### Q2. Bebop emphasises navigating chord changes chromatically.

**Answer:** True
